terms.title: Terms & Affiliate Disclosure
terms.intro: Chalet Express is an independent travel directory dedicated to showcasing Canadian chalet rentals. We participate in the VRBO (Expedia Group) Affiliate Program, which means we may earn a commission when you book a stay through links on our site — at no additional cost to you.

sections.heading: Affiliate Relationship
sections.body: Chalet Express is not a property manager or booking agent. We curate and display chalet listings from VRBO and other partners. When you click a booking button or use the search widget, you will be redirected to VRBO's platform to complete your reservation. We may receive a commission for qualifying bookings made through our affiliate links.

sections.heading: Pricing & Availability
sections.body: All prices displayed on Chalet Express are approximate and based on data available at the time of publication. Actual pricing, availability, and property details are subject to change and should be verified directly on VRBO before booking. Chalet Express does not guarantee the accuracy of pricing or availability information.

sections.heading: No Warranty
sections.body: Chalet Express provides all information on an "as is" basis without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not warrant that the information is accurate, complete, or current. Your use of the site and any reliance on its content is at your own risk.

sections.heading: Third-Party Links
sections.body: Our site contains links to third-party websites (including VRBO and Expedia Group properties). We are not responsible for the content, privacy policies, or practices of these external sites. Your interactions with third-party websites are solely between you and that website.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Chalet Express shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of or inability to use the site, including but not limited to booking errors, property misrepresentations, or travel disruptions.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions about these terms or our affiliate relationships, please reach out via the contact information in our sidebar or footer.
